name: Tai Tung Communication Co., Ltd.
summary: Tai Tung Communication Co., Ltd., a Taiwanese entity, specializes in the production and sale of a broad spectrum of communication cables. Their extensive fiber optic cable lineup includes options for loose tube ducting, direct burial or aerial deployment, all-dielectric self-supporting (ADSS) applications, slotted-core ribbon types, indoor environments, drop connections, and micro-soft metal armored versions. Beyond cables, the company also supplies Passive Optical Network (PON) products, such as closures, rack-mountable patch panels, and various high-density and wall-mount fiber distribution frames. Additionally, Tai Tung offers a range of fiber optic accessories, including launch test cables, patch cords, fan-out fiber cords, adapters, optical splitters, and connector cleaning implements. Their product range extends to copper cables, which encompass telecommunication, coaxial, and power cables. Founded in 1981, the company was initially known as Tai Tung Electric Wire & Cable Co., Ltd. before officially changing its name to Tai Tung Communication Co., Ltd. in 2000. Its main operational base is situated in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
